problemSigns.sign: Opener hums but the door doesn't move
problemSigns.detail: The motor runs, but the door remains stationary. This often indicates a stripped gear or disconnected trolley.

problemSigns.sign: Door reverses before touching the floor
problemSigns.detail: The door starts to close, then opens again. This points to an issue with the safety sensors or the down-limit settings.
The wall button works, but remote controls or the outdoor keypad do not. This can be a signal issue or a logic board problem.
The small lights on your safety sensors are flashing. This means the sensors are misaligned, obstructed, or faulty.

problemSigns.sign: Trolley moves but door stays down
problemSigns.detail: The trolley carriage travels along the rail, but the door itself does not move. This suggests the opener is disengaged from the door.
